title: Underground US rapid reaction facility at Coyame, Mexico
summary: UAPGerb tells of Underground US rapid reaction facility at Coyame, Mexico, about 2004 onward at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: suggest that, you know, maybe there's an underground US rapid reaction facility in Coyame, Mexico in the north part of Mexico

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb suggests, drawing on a man named Jake Barber and a source called Sentinels of Ether, that there may be an underground US facility near Coyame in northern Mexico. He describes it as a rapid reaction site, meaning a base for responding quickly, starting around 2004. If true, it would mean the US keeps a hidden base abroad for fast response to UFO events.
